title: 第3章 纯阳道体第4章 九劫纯阳经
content_zh:
;;
“双…双修？！”
周尘脸色瞬间煞白，惊恐地连退数步。
这算什么正经方法？！
眼前这位羲和女帝固然风华绝代，美若天仙。
但刚刚才经历吕玉清那妖女惨无人道的采补，周尘此刻对任何靠近他的绝色女子都充满警惕！
越是美丽的女人，越是危险！
这位羲和女帝，比吕玉清更甚百倍！
羲和女帝秀眉微蹙，显然有些不耐，冷哼一声：
“蠢货，你的纯阳道体，乃是诸天至阳本源所化，是这世间最为纯粹无垢的元阳宝体！”
“对本座这等存在而言，更是无上大药，万载难逢的机缘！”
“你以为本座现身于此，会放过此等造化？！”
“不要抗拒，你也有好处！”
“不！我不信！”周尘死死攥紧拳头，眼中满是抗拒，“吕玉清就是这样采补我的！我绝不会再重蹈覆辙！”
可他话音未落，羲和女帝已探出手，指尖轻点他的眉心。
“哼！由不得你！”
周尘只觉浑身一僵，连动弹一根手指的力气都没了。
只见羲和女帝素手轻抬，指尖划过虚空，那身胜雪的白衣竟如同被迅速剥落，化作点点星光消散！
绝世风光，刹那展现！
一具完美到令人窒息的胴体缓缓显露。

长发如瀑，半掩着惊心动魄的曲线，柳腰纤细，向下延伸是浑圆饱满的弧度，一双修长玉腿笔直匀称。
肌肤胜雪，光滑细腻，不见丝毫瑕疵。
“呃啊——！”
周尘只觉一股无法抗拒的力量涌入体内，瞬间撕裂了他残存的抵抗。
纯阳道体被强行引动，一股灼热澎湃的纯阳本源不受控制地奔涌而出！
“你…你…你，别过来！”
反抗终究是徒劳。
周尘被她轻轻一带，便跌入一个温软的怀抱。
烛影摇红，纱幔轻舞。
“唔……”
一声压抑低吟溢出。
content_en:
;;
"Double...double cultivation?!"
Zhou Chen's face instantly turned pale, and he took several steps back in horror.
What kind of serious method is this? !
The Empress Xihe in front of her was indeed unparalleled in elegance and beauty.
But having just experienced the cruel and inhumane tonic from Lu Yuqing, Zhou Chen was now wary of any stunning woman approaching him!
The more beautiful a woman is, the more dangerous she is!
This Empress Xihe is a hundred times more powerful than Lu Yuqing!
Empress Xihe frowned slightly, obviously a little impatient, and snorted coldly:
"Idiot, your pure Yang Tao body is transformed from the origin of the Yang of all heavens. It is the purest and unsullied Yuanyang treasure body in the world!"
"For beings like me, this is the ultimate medicine and a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity!"
"Do you think I will let go of this fate when I show up here?!"
"Don't resist, it's good for you too!"
"No! I don't believe it!" Zhou Chen clenched his fists tightly, his eyes full of resistance, "This is how Lu Yuqing picked me up! I will never make the same mistake again!"
But before he finished speaking, Empress Xihe reached out her hand and tapped his forehead with her fingertips.
"Hmph! You can't help it!"
Zhou Chen felt his whole body stiffen, and he didn't even have the strength to move a finger.
I saw Xi He and Empress Su raising their hands lightly, and their fingertips traced across the void. The snow-like white clothes on their bodies seemed to be peeled off quickly, turning into little stars and dissipating!
The peerless scenery unfolds in an instant!
A body that was so perfect that it was breathtaking was slowly revealed.
The long hair is like a waterfall, half covering the thrilling curves. The waist is slender, extending downward into a round and full arc, and a pair of slender legs are straight and well-proportioned.
The skin is better than snow, smooth and delicate, without any blemishes.
"Uh-huh!"
Zhou Chen felt an irresistible force pouring into his body, instantly tearing apart his remaining resistance.
The Pure Yang Dao body was forcibly aroused, and a hot source of Pure Yang surged out uncontrollably!
"You...you...you, don't come here!"
Resistance is ultimately futile.
Zhou Chen was gently carried by her and fell into a gentle embrace.
The candle shadow shakes red and the gauze curtain dances lightly.
"Well..."
A muffled groan escaped.
